title: Webhook creation returns HTTP 500
description: Webhook creation can fail when the callback URL does not use HTTPS.
resolution: Verify that the webhook callback URL uses HTTPS and retry the request.

title: Webhook delivery failures
description: Webhook deliveries may fail when the customer endpoint returns HTTP 4xx or 5xx responses.
resolution: Check the customer endpoint response and verify that the endpoint is accepting webhook requests.

title: Authentication failure after API upgrade
description: API authentication can fail after an integration upgrade when an outdated authentication mechanism is still being used.
resolution: Verify that the integration is using the current authentication mechanism and credentials.
